c: Camperbot has created a coding journey blog page, but it looks like the page has some accessibility issues and bad practices. Your job in this workshop, is to fix these issues for Camperbot.
The first set of errors has to deal with the use of headings. In a prior lesson, you learned that it is best practice to only use one
per page. But it looks like Camperbot is a using a few

const heading = document.querySelectorAll("h1")[0];
assert.equal(heading?.textContent, "Welcome to Camperbot's Blog");

c: Below the main title of the page, there is a navigation section that contains links to each blog post.
This section should be wrapped in a
element to indicate its purpose as a navigation landmark.

hints.test:
const navElement = document.querySelector("nav");
assert.isNotNull(navElement);

const ulElement = document.querySelector("nav ul");
assert.isNotNull(ulElement);

const liElements = document.querySelectorAll("nav ul li");
assert.isAtLeast(liElements.length, 3);
